summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting of Star Fashion Culture Holdings Ltd, a foreign private issuer. Shareholders approved two proposals: (1) revision of terms for allotting up to 5,000,000 Class B shares to Xingji Zhangpingting Limited, with consideration to be determined by a valuation report; (2) authorization of an offering of up to 10,000,000 Class A shares via a Form F-1 registration statement. Both items are ordinary capital-raising and administrative authorizations. No price, premium, or timeline for a special-situation transaction is stated. This is a routine meeting report, not a special situation.
